title: Meet EcoDecors: Personalized Teak Products, Now Inside Customily
summary: Meet EcoDecors, a new POD provider inside Customily, offering personalized teak boards, pizza boards, bath caddies, bathtub trays, amenity trays, and more.
body_markdown:
Another Print on Demand provider is joining[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) ! And this one brings a new range of premium teak products merchants can turn into personalized gifts, home accessories, entertaining essentials, and more.


We’re excited to welcome[EcoDecors](https://decoteak.com/collections/ecodecors) as a new POD provider inside Customily, with a collection that goes well beyond the kitchen.


From **personalized boards and pizza-style serving boards to bathtub trays, bath caddies, and amenity trays** , EcoDecors gives merchants new product formats to personalize for different audiences, occasions, and niches.


With the EcoDecors + Customily integration, merchants can create personalized products, offer customization to their shoppers, and connect personalized orders directly with EcoDecors for production and fulfillment.


## Personalized Teak Products Coming to Customily


[EcoDecors](https://decoteak.com/collections/ecodecors) gives merchants several teak product formats to work with across **kitchen, entertaining, gifting, bathroom, home, and hospitality collections** .


Rather than listing every individual size and variation, here are the main product categories merchants can explore.


### 1. Angle Handle Boards


EcoDecors’ **Angle Handle Boards** combine a rectangular serving surface with a distinctive angled handle, giving the product a more decorative and giftable look.


They are available in **Small, Medium, and Large** , which gives merchants flexibility to offer different price points or multiple size options within the same personalized collection.


These boards are especially well suited for engraved family names, monograms, established dates, wedding designs, housewarming gifts, hostess gifts, and entertaining-themed personalization.


Because of their shape, they can work as both functional serving pieces and personalized display products for the kitchen or dining area.


### 2. Rectangular Boards


The **Rectangular Boards** offer a more traditional format, with a wide engraving area that works well for both simple and more detailed personalized designs.


Depending on the style, merchants can use this format for names, recipes, family designs, monograms, illustrations, custom messages, BBQ themes, or entertaining-focused artwork.


Their straightforward shape also makes them easy to position across different niches, from everyday kitchen gifts to weddings, housewarmings, anniversaries, and holiday collections.


### 3. Pizza Style Boards


EcoDecors also offers **round pizza-style boards with handles** , available in **Small, Medium, and Large** options.


The circular format creates a different canvas for personalization and works particularly well with curved text, central monograms, family names, pizza-night themes, or decorative illustrations.


Although they naturally fit pizza and food-related concepts, they can also be used as personalized serving boards for cheese, appetizers, desserts, and entertaining.


### 4. Amenity Trays


EcoDecors’ **Amenity Tray** introduces a completely different type of personalized product.


Its long rectangular format makes it suitable for bathrooms, guest rooms, vanities, entryways, bedrooms, and hospitality spaces.


For consumer-facing stores, personalization could include names, monograms, initials, meaningful dates, or decorative artwork.


For B2B sellers, amenity trays also create opportunities for **hotels, spas, vacation rentals, wellness businesses, and other hospitality brands** .


### 5. Bathtub Trays


EcoDecors offers **bathtub trays in multiple lengths** , including 30", 36", 42", and 50" options.


These products expand the collection into **self-care, wellness, bathroom decor, and gifting** .


Personalization can include names, monograms, couples’ designs, wedding or anniversary details, new-home designs, or spa-inspired artwork.


The different lengths also give merchants flexibility to offer more than one option depending on the shopper’s bathtub setup and preferred style.


### 6. Bath Caddies


Merchants can also choose from **29" and 34" bath caddies** , including versions with and without handles.


Bath caddies are particularly well suited to premium home and wellness collections and can be positioned around relaxation, self-care, weddings, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, housewarmings, and holiday gifting.


They’re also a good way for personalization-focused stores to expand beyond the more common kitchen and gift categories while still targeting the same home-and-lifestyle shopper.


## One Collection, Many Personalization Opportunities


What makes the EcoDecors catalog especially interesting is that merchants aren’t limited to a single use case.


An **Angle Handle Board** can become a personalized wedding gift, a family entertaining piece, or a housewarming keepsake.


A **Pizza Style Board** can target food lovers, couples, families, or shoppers looking for a personalized hosting accessory.


A **Bath Caddy** can become a self-care gift, anniversary present, or premium home accessory.


And an **Amenity Tray** can work equally well in a personalized home collection or as a branded product for hospitality businesses.


That gives merchants room to build collections around different audiences and occasions while working with a relatively focused selection of premium teak products.


**Personalization ideas can include:**


- Family names and established dates
- Monograms and initials
- Wedding and anniversary designs
- Housewarming and new-home gifts
- Custom illustrations
- Handwritten recipes or messages
- Food and entertaining themes
- Self-care and wellness designs
- Couples’ gifts
- Hospitality branding
- Vacation rental and hotel products
- Customer-uploaded artwork


Instead of selling the same generic teak product as everyone else, merchants can use[personalization](https://www.customily.com/our-features) to turn each format into a product designed for a specific shopper, niche, or occasion.


## From Kitchen Gifts to Personalized Home & Bath Collections


One of the biggest advantages of the EcoDecors catalog is the number of different directions merchants can take with it.


A merchant focused on **food and entertaining** can build collections around Angle Handle Boards, Rectangular Boards, Pizza Style Boards, weddings, hosting, family gatherings, and housewarming gifts.


A **home and gifting store** can combine kitchen products with bath caddies and trays to build broader wedding, anniversary, new-home, Mother’s Day, or holiday collections.


A **wellness-focused brand** could build personalized self-care products around bathtub trays and bath caddies.


And merchants selling to businesses can explore **hospitality and vacation-rental niches** with personalized or branded amenity trays, serving pieces, and other teak accessories.


The product itself is only the starting point. **Personalization is what creates the niche.**


## How the Customily + EcoDecors Workflow Works


The advantage of connecting[Customily](https://app.customily.com/stamp/blogecodecors) with **EcoDecors** is that the process from personalized order to fulfillment can be handled through a connected workflow.


Here’s how it works:


- Your customer personalizes the product in your store.
- Customily automatically generates the production-ready file with their personalization applied.
- The order information and personalized production file are sent to EcoDecors.
- EcoDecors produces the personalized teak product with the submitted design.
- The finished product is fulfilled and shipped to the customer.
- You can focus on creating new designs, reaching different niches, and growing your personalized product catalog.


This allows merchants to sell personalized products without having to manually prepare each production file or stock and produce the items themselves.


## How to Publish Personalized EcoDecors Products with Customily


Getting an EcoDecors product ready to sell follows the same straightforward workflow already used inside[Customily](https://app.customily.com/stamp/blogecodecors) .


1. Connect your EcoDecors account from the integrations section of your Customily dashboard.
2. Click **Create a new product** .
3. Select EcoDecors as your Print on Demand provider.
4. Browse the available products and choose the category, size, and style you want to sell.
5. Add your artwork and configure the personalization experience for your customers.
6. Adjust your design to fit the personalization area of the selected product.
7. Click **Publish** to make your personalized product available in your store.


Once published, the product is ready to receive **personalized orders** and send them through the connected production and fulfillment workflow.


## Start Selling Personalized Teak Products with Customily + EcoDecors


EcoDecors brings a new type of product catalog to Customily, combining the premium look of natural teak with formats shoppers can use throughout their homes.


From **personalized boards for cooking and entertaining to bath caddies, bathtub trays, and amenity trays for home and hospitality** , merchants now have more ways to create products around gifting, food, home, wellness, and special occasions.


Choose the products that make sense for your audience, create a personalization experience around them, and let Customily + EcoDecors connect the personalized order with production and fulfillment.


Whether you want to build a collection around personalized family boards, wedding gifts, pizza-night designs, self-care accessories, hospitality products, or something entirely different, EcoDecors gives you the base products to make it happen.


**Happy Customizing! ⭐**


### Frequently Asked Questions


**What EcoDecors products can I personalize with Customily?**


The EcoDecors catalog available through Customily includes several teak product categories, such as **Angle Handle Boards, Rectangular Boards, Pizza Style Boards, Amenity Trays, Bathtub Trays, and Bath Caddies** .


Depending on the product, merchants can also choose from different sizes and styles.


**What can I personalize on EcoDecors products?**


Merchants can create personalization experiences around elements such as **names, monograms, dates, custom messages, illustrations, artwork, and customer-uploaded designs** .


The exact personalization possibilities will depend on the product and the experience you create in Customily.


**Are EcoDecors products only for kitchen and food-related stores?**


No. While the boards are a natural fit for kitchen and entertaining collections, EcoDecors also offers products for **home, bath, wellness, gifting, and hospitality** .


Bathtub trays and bath caddies can work particularly well for self-care and home-gifting niches, while amenity trays can also be positioned for hotels, vacation rentals, spas, and other hospitality businesses.


**What sizes are available for the Angle Handle Boards?**


EcoDecors’ **Angle Handle Boards are available in Small, Medium, and Large** .


Offering multiple sizes can help merchants create different price points or give shoppers more flexibility within the same personalized collection.


**What sizes are available for the Pizza Style Boards?**


The **Pizza Style Boards are also available in Small, Medium, and Large** .


Their round shape gives merchants a different personalization canvas, making them particularly suitable for curved typography, monograms, family-name designs, illustrations, or food and entertaining themes.


**What bathtub and bath products does EcoDecors offer?**


The collection includes **bathtub trays in 30", 36", 42", and 50" lengths** , as well as **29" and 34" bath caddies** , with some caddy options available with handles.


This gives merchants several ways to create personalized products for self-care, wellness, bathroom decor, weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, and other gifting occasions.


**How does fulfillment work with EcoDecors and Customily?**


When a shopper places a personalized order, **Customily generates the production-ready file with the customer’s personalization applied** .


The order information and file are then sent through the connected workflow to EcoDecors for production and fulfillment. This allows merchants to sell personalized products without producing or stocking the items themselves.


**Can I use EcoDecors products for corporate or hospitality orders?**


Yes. Products such as **Amenity Trays, serving boards, and other personalized teak accessories** can work well for hotels, spas, vacation rentals, restaurants, real estate gifting, and other B2B applications.


Merchants can build personalization around logos, names, branded artwork, or designs created for a specific business or property.


**How do I start selling EcoDecors products with Customily?**


Connect your EcoDecors account from Customily, create a new product, select EcoDecors as your Print on Demand provider, choose the product you want to offer, configure its personalization, and publish it to your store.
